what a failing hex0 is doing: not decoding a lowercase pair high-nibble-first
treating A-F as digits: the alphabet is lowercase 0-9 a-f only
resetting the pending nibble at a comment, or ending the comment early
letting a non-digit (space, tab, CR, ':', 'z', 'G', '-', '=', '}', '&', '%') emit or change state
failing or emitting on empty input
running off the end of input inside an unterminated comment
mis-decoding some digit, or reordering bytes
ending a comment at a lone CR: only LF ends a comment, so "a" is comment text and the "4" is left unpaired
mishandling a CRLF line ending (the CR is comment text, the LF ends the comment)
